claims.question: What content format do Confluence Data Center pages use for API writes?
claims.skill_answer: Storage format (XHTML-based), not ADF; ADF does not apply to Confluence DC.

claims.question: Which Confluence REST API versions are available on Data Center versus Cloud?
claims.skill_answer: DC: v1 only (/rest/api/content, start/limit); Cloud: v1 and v2 (/wiki/api/v2, cursor paging).

claims.question: Does Confluence Data Center support native page-level archiving?
claims.skill_answer: No — space-level only (CONFSERVER-31010); move pages to an archive space instead.

claims.question: What is the recommended maximum number of spaces on Confluence Data Center before performance degrades?
claims.skill_answer: Under 8,000 spaces optimal; 8–10k approaching limits; over 10k degraded.

Which user identifier does the Confluence API use on Data Center versus Cloud?
claims.skill_answer: DC uses username/userKey; Cloud uses accountId.

claims.question: Do Confluence view restrictions and edit restrictions cascade to child pages?
claims.skill_answer: View restrictions cascade to children; edit restrictions do not.

claims.question: Can a Confluence page restriction grant view access to a user lacking space View permission?
claims.skill_answer: No — page restrictions only subtract; space permissions are additive.
